text:
Sam (AE): Hey team — urgent coordination. POC is greenlit but procurement/legal are blocking signature. Need signer mapping for order form, confirmation on pricing for dedicated POC, and the security questionnaire answers to hand off. Customer requires KMS/BYOK and EU data residency. Can legal/finance/PS weigh in?

Jordan (Solutions): Quick clarifying Qs — is this a trial POC (no charge) or a committed reserved pool? The KMS + private infra usually bumps price. Also who will sign on customer side (procurement vs technical)?

Sam (AE): It's a 3-month dedicated POC; customer will issue a PO (net45). They want Redwood MSA + DPA with a couple of redlines: audit log retention 7 years, and an explicit KMS addendum. I'll paste a bare-bones order form below.

Sam (AE): ```
Order Form (draft)
- Customer: Helios Biotech GmbH
- Product: Dedicated-Pool (POC)
- Term: 3 months
- Billing: Net45, billing@helios.io
- Price (negotiated): $9,000 / month (POC discount)
- Special: BYOK (HSM) required, EU region
```

Elaine (Legal): Thanks — high-level: we can accept DPA redlines but 7-year audit retention is outside our default (we normally do 12 months / 1 year). If they're in Germany (DE), choice of law and data export clauses matter — confirm jurisdiction. KMS/BYOK: we have an HSM/KMS addendum template we can attach; customer needs to provide key exchange method and attestations. Please upload their marked-up MSA/DPA. Note: avoid custom indemnity language; we prefer our standard limits.

ContractsBot: Created e-sign envelope env_0xA1B2. Required Redwood signers: "VP Revenue" and "Legal Director" by default. Please confirm if you want a single executive signer instead.

Mike (Finance): Net45 is ok for enterprise POs but flagging that for reserved capacity we prefer prepaid commitments. If this is invoiced month-to-month at discounted POC rate, we need the PO to reference the negotiated sku and the billing contact. Who owns renewal/upgrade pricing after POC? Also confirm whether tax forms are needed (we'll need their VAT ID).

Katerina (PS): For Private/KMS setup + EU residency we'll need ~2-3 weeks to provision and validate. On-prem or customer VPC adds effort and license cost. I'll estimate SOW and time; if they require HSM cert exchange we'll need the contact info and cert format. If on-prem, expect a ~50% uplift to list POC price.

Jordan (Solutions): Action checklist: (1) Sam to upload customer's redlines and PO (2) Elaine to review and propose DPA/MSA negotiation points (3) ContractsBot to prepare envelope with Redwood signers (4) Mike to confirm billing flow and VAT handling (5) Katerina to draft SOW estimate and lead time. Proposed sync: tomorrow 10:00am PT.

Sam (AE): I'll upload the redline PDF and the procurement contact in ~1 hour. @Elaine any chance you can pre-approve the KMS addendum template so we can include it when we send the envelope? Also customer asked for SOC2 report and most recent pentest attestation — can we share under NDA?

Elaine (Legal): @Sam yes — I'll pre-approve the KMS addendum (boilerplate) and prepare a SOC2 + pen test bundle to share under a one-way NDA. Regarding audit retention, I'll propose a compromise of 3 years and escalate if they push for 7. See you at 10am PT. :thumbsup:
